patch_list: Bypass proxy/VPN security block

Stops the "Something is interfering with your secure connection" (NET_201) screen that JioHotstar shows when it detects a VPN/proxy. The app self-enforces a proxy verdict the server sends via the X-Hs-SetProxyState response header: the cli…
Change app name
Changes the app name shown under the launcher icon. Set the desired name in the patch options.
Disable analytics

Disables Firebase/Google Analytics, Crashlytics and Performance data collection via manifest flags. CleverTap is left intact (it drives in-app UI and disabling it would crash the app). Push notifications are unaffected.
Enable all codecs

Forces all video codecs (H265/VP9/AV1) and 4K support on by bypassing the capability/blacklist checks. Off by default: forcing a codec/resolution a TV cannot actually decode can break playback. Approach adapted from Paresh-Maheshwari's pat…
Enable screen mirroring

Allows playback to continue while screen mirroring or an external HDMI display is connected, instead of showing the multiple-display block. Approach adapted from Paresh-Maheshwari's patches (GPL-3.0).
Enable screenshots
Removes screenshot and screen-recording restrictions on the app UI (the DRM video itself stays protected by Widevine). Approach adapted from Paresh-Maheshwari's patches (GPL-3.0).
Force HDR10

Forces HDR10 / HDR10+ / Dolby Vision playback by bypassing the capability/blacklist check. Off by default: forcing HDR on a panel that cannot render it can wash out or break playback. Approach adapted from Paresh-Maheshwari's patches (GPL-…
Make installable on TV

Premium unlock

Remove AD_ID permission
Removes the advertising-id and Ad Services (Privacy Sandbox) permissions so the device advertising id, Attribution and Topics signals cannot be read for ad tracking.
Remove ads

Removes pre-roll, mid-roll and live-match video ads by clearing the SSAI ad tag in the AdMetadata constructor, so the client requests a clean, non-ad-stitched stream at the source. This surgical approach lets the app's own ad machinery see…
Spoof device attestation

Spoof device id

Spoof device-integrity self-report
